reviews.title: Visible results in just one week
reviews.body: Wow, what a difference in just one weekI’ve been using this cream for seven days and can already see a noticeable improvement in my skin’s appearance. It looks so much softer and more even toned, with far less blotchiness. I’m honestly obsessed and excited to see the results after a full month of use. The jar is small, but no smaller than other expensive products I’ve tried, and a little really goes a long way. I’m just so happy with this product.Read moreRead less
reviews.author: Logan

reviews.title: Best I've ever used!
reviews.body: I'm one picky B**** when it comes to face creams. I'm a dialysis patient which makes my skin very dry and dull. This came first in an Ipsy bag as a sample, and from that day I was hooked. I feel like my face is more even, and the fine lines are less noticeable and I have a dewy glow that I love. This stuff is so luxurious feeling, almost gel-like for a cream, and I can describe my face as plump and nourished. If you're looking for something to make it easy to blend your makeup, this is it. It's not sticky or too thick. I'd like for it to come in a glass jar better than plastic, but I'm not that picky where I won't purchase it over that. I just bought this again for Black Friday because they have a bigger one on their website for 25% off. I paid $65 for I believe a 2.5 ounce jar. I think this product is too expensive, but if it's on sale, I'm getting more. I like the applicator it comes with as well. A lot of times I wear fake nails and it bugs the crap out of me when creams or lotions get under my nails. If you have oily skin this isn't the product you want to use. They have a green jar for oily skin, but it has a strong alcohol scent to it. Alcohol even with oily skin isn't good, so I'm not on board with that product. But this one I absolutely, 100% recommend.Read moreRead less

features: A RICH CREAM that feeds skin with plumping hydration and antioxidant-packed Japanese purple rice for a dewy, healthy glow. Ideal for dry skin, but can be used on combo skin for those who prefer a richer texture.

INTENSELY HYDRATES and seals in moisture, helping to replenish ceramides for a healthy bounce and instant luminosity. A fermentation of Japanese anti-aging superfoods — green tea, rice, and algae — helps skin to look its most beautiful at any age.

BOTANICAL EXTRACTS: A blend of extracts and oils from ginseng, wild thyme, and sweet marjoram nourishes skin, enhancing its natural ability to retain and release moisture as needed, and imparts a dewy glow.
IDEAL for Firming, Smoothing, Resurfacing & Plumping

BEAUTIFUL FACES, BEAUTIFUL FUTURES: Every Tatcha purchase supports education equality worldwide. As of 2021, your purchases also bring diverse books to underserved communities in the United States through Room to Read’s U.S. Literacy Initiative.
